definitions.explanation: To scatter or plant seeds in soil.

examples.japanese: {畑|はたけ}に{野菜|やさい}の{種|たね}を蒔く。
examples.english: To sow vegetable seeds in the field.

notes:
蒔く specifically means planting seeds.

HOMOPHONES:
- {巻|ま}く: to wind, roll
- {撒|ま}く: to scatter, sprinkle

IDIOM:
- {蒔|ま}いた{種|たね}: what one has sown (consequences of actions)
